english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something situated toward or facing the northwest, such as a northwest-facing route or window.

examples.english: The living room in this flat faces northwest, so it gets a bit colder in winter.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋個客廳係西北向，冬天會凍啲。
